name: Assassin's Contract
summary: A Shadowy Assassin in Hillsbrad Foothills carries a contract that orders the killing of Magistrate Henry Maleb. Red wax seals it, pressed with a distinctive signet ring, and you are to bring it to Maleb in Southshore.

sections.title: A Marked Magistrate
sections.body: The paper orders the killing of Magistrate Henry Maleb. A seal of red wax closes it, pressed with a distinctive signet ring. A Shadowy Assassin in Hillsbrad Foothills carries it, and Maleb in Southshore is the one to show it to.

sections.title: Maleb's Verdict
sections.body: Maleb looks over the contract and says it accounts for the recent attack on Southshore. Maleb is certain the Syndicate is after the magistrate's life, as it was after the previous magistrate's.

faq.q: What is written in the contract?
faq.answer: It orders the killing of Magistrate Henry Maleb, and red wax seals it, pressed with a distinctive signet ring.
It is carried by a Shadowy Assassin in Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: To whom should the contract be delivered?
aliases: who do I give the contract to
where to turn in assassins contract
faq.answer: To Magistrate Henry Maleb in Southshore, the magistrate the contract marks for death.
